Arpeggiator.STEPS: Number of steps in the sequence; 1-128
Arpeggiator.LENGTH: Gate length of each step; 0-110%; values above 100% overlap the next note
Arpeggiator.STRIKES: Times each step triggers before advancing; 1-4
Arpeggiator.RESOLUTION: Step length relative to host BPM; 32 bars down to 64th-note triplet
Arpeggiator.HOLD: Latch that sustains active notes indefinitely
Arpeggiator.OCTAVE: Octave range of the pattern; -6 to 6 octaves
Arpeggiator.GROOVE: Groove amount applied to the pattern; 0-100%
Arpeggiator.ARP/VEL BLEND: Mix of arp velocity with incoming note velocity; 0% = arp velocity only
Arpeggiator.TRIGGER: Trigger mode: NOTE, LEGATO, SONG POSITION
Arpeggiator.NOTE REPEAT: Repeats the bottom or top note of the pattern
Arpeggiator.VELOCITY: Per-step level, 0-100%, mapped to MIDI 1-127 and blended with input velocity
Arpeggiator.PITCH: Per-step semitone offset from the incoming note; -48 to 48 semitones
Arpeggiator.STEP STATE: Per-step: Off (silent), On (plays), Merged (joins prior step), Tied (legato into next)
Arpeggiator.STEP SIZE: Per-step duration as a proportion of its slot, 0-100%; multiplies LENGTH

MIDI Out.MIDI CHANNEL: Output channel for events; AS IS, or 1-16

MIDI Player.BASE NOTE: Note that triggers playback; MIDI note number 0-127
MIDI Player.TRANSPOSE: When on, all notes trigger playback transposed from Base Note
MIDI Player.LOOP: Loops the MIDI file continuously after triggering
MIDI Player.AUTOPLAY: Starts playback automatically when Falcon starts playing
